mode: Live capture and frame generation, no analysis recording or video export
settings_source: Visually checked in the application before and after sampling
limits: GPU utilization, VRAM and power describe the entire GPU, including other running applications.
Desktop apps were left open; this is not an isolated benchmark.
GPU timing in the application is the last sampled generated-frame operation plus GPU output copy, not total application frame time.
No physical monitor scanout, input-to-photon or CPU bottleneck measurement.
One approximately 30-second run per mode; modes are sequential and use different gameplay. No repeated-trial confidence interval.
scene: User-controlled moving PS5 gameplay / camera motion, visually verified before and after sampling; no scripted identical path.
